purpose: Operator-requested larger per-visit batches; compare assumed operational settings, not algorithm causal efficiency or model accuracy.
policy: All supported sites screened with unchanged H19 marginal loss/costs.12receiver+12donor+5legacy locations<=29. Supply capped by vehicle capacity,current-target,10percentile-target,minimum128samples. Delivery<=min(operator drop_limit,ceil(target-lower10percentile)). No unverified parking claim.
search: Deterministic beam64/max8visits, integer quantities, empty-start/return, noaction and exhaustive feasible2stop fallback. Union subcapacities1..min(requested_capacity,budget,floor(effective_deadline_seconds/(2*handling_seconds))). This bound follows unavoidable pickup+drop handling. Legacy H17 route fallback omitted because it assumes6sec handling. No citywide optimum.
timing: Calibrated current departure, original10min forecast expiry,30sec computation reserve; route driving+all pickups/drops+return must fit. No30/60min forecast assertion. Longer handling can reduce feasible volume; do not bypass it.
evaluation: 72seed44synthetic resource conditions, independent conservation/donor/drop/capacity/elapsed-handling checks. Gate zero failures and at least one bulk feasible delivery batch>=5bikes. Report all counts and solverlatency. One current-state full-horizon replay plus actual now RPC for integration only, no winner selection from API truth.
compute: dislab CPU only; local UI/source/transport QA
resources: One vehicle;20capacity,target6,drop10,20sec/bike are explicit scenario assumptions, not verified Tashu resources
separation: H19/H20 frozen plans and results unchanged. Source-conflict UI repair is separate maintenance PR29. No model training/threshold/calibration/accuracy work.
